qualifier: sensing, end processing and pathway choice with BRCA1/BRCA2-PALB2 defects and protein ADP-ribosylation
name: Double-strand break repair choice, BRCA defects and ADP-ribosylation
rationale: All members concern sensing, resection and repair of DNA double-strand breaks (HR, NHEJ, SSA, MMEJ) or the PARylation and BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2 defects acting there, which the interstrand cross-link and replication-stress confusables lack.

qualifier: myeloid colony-stimulating factor production and macrophage/dendritic differentiation
name: Bone marrow cell homeostasis and myeloid colony-stimulating factor production
rationale: Members cover bone marrow cell survival, proliferation and number plus G-CSF/M-CSF production and macrophage/myeloid DC differentiation, distinct from the stem-cell, RUNX1 and CSF-receptor signalling confusables.

qualifier: phosphatidylethanolamine
name: Phosphatidylethanolamine-specific glycerophospholipid acyl-chain remodeling
rationale: All three members describe glycerophospholipid metabolism focused on PE acyl-chain exchange, unlike the eicosanoid and DAG/TAG/PA confusables.

qualifier: Trk receptors (TRKA/B/C) to RAS, PI3K and PLC-gamma with p75NTR survival
name: Neurotrophin Trk receptor trophic signaling via RAS, PI3K, PLCγ
rationale: Members are NGF/BDNF/NT-3/NT-4 signalling through NTRK1-3 and their RAS, PI3K, PLCG1, FRS2 and CREB effectors, whereas confusables centre on p75NTR death signalling or generic MAPK cascades.

qualifier: osteoclast and mineralization control with IGF response
name: Osteoclast-driven bone remodeling, mineralization control and IGF response
rationale: Members regulate osteoclast differentiation/fusion, bone resorption, mineralization and chondrocyte development alongside IGF responses, whereas confusables are osteoblast/Wnt or tooth mineralization themes.

qualifier: including GPER1 and estrous cycle
name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling, including GPER1
rationale: Members are cellular responses to estradiol and progesterone, ER regulation, GPER1 and estrous cycle, whereas confusables add androgen receptor and hallmark estrogen-response sets.

qualifier: UV-A/UV-B and blue light, plus phorbol ester
name: UV, blue light and phorbol ester stress responses
rationale: Members are cellular responses to UV-A, UV-B, blue light and PMA (UV up/down hallmarks), distinct from the liver, MITF and TNF/NF-kB confusables.

qualifier: vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors
name: Vitamin K metabolism and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members cover vitamin K/menaquinone catabolism and response plus gamma-carboxylation, propeptide removal and ER-Golgi transport of carboxylated precursors, unlike the coagulation, other-vitamin and isoprenoid confusables.

core: ER membrane organization and inter-organelle contacts
qualifier: ER tubule shaping, organelle tethering and lipid transfer
name: ER tubule shaping and inter-organelle contact lipid transfer
rationale: Members concern ER tubular network formation, ER-mitochondria/plasma membrane tethering, Miro GTPases and phospholipid/cholesterol transfer between membranes, which the Golgi traffic, flippase and phosphoinositide confusables lack.

qualifier: phenotypic switching and vessel remodeling
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and vessel remodeling
rationale: Members regulate VSMC proliferation, migration, apoptosis, differentiation and dedifferentiation and vascular remodeling, versus endothelial-focused and cardiac muscle confusables.

qualifier: amyloid-beta and apoptotic cell clearance
name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance
rationale: Members cover microglial activation, migration, proliferation and cytotoxicity together with amyloid fibril and amyloid-beta clearance and apoptotic cell clearance, whereas confusables emphasise amyloid formation, astrocytes and synaptic effects.

qualifier: creatine-phosphocreatine shuttle and ADP/ATP interconversion and mitochondrial transport
name: Phosphocreatine shuttle and adenine nucleotide interconversion
rationale: Members are creatine/phosphocreatine metabolism, nucleotide di/triphosphate interconversion and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport, distinct from NAD, GTP and nucleoside transport confusables.

qualifier: p75NTR and dependence receptors, with NGF processing
name: Neurotrophin processing and p75NTR/dependence receptor death signaling
rationale: Members are proNGF/NGF processing, p75NTR binding and NADE/NRAGE/ceramide death signalling and ligand-free dependence receptor caspase activation, which the Trk survival and axon regeneration confusables lack.

qualifier: bacterial attachment, agglutination and cytolysis
name: Mucosal innate defense: bacterial attachment, agglutination, cytolysis
rationale: Members concern host-microbe contact at mucosa: bacterial attachment to epithelia, agglutination, cytolysis of symbionts and mucosal innate immunity, rather than the defensin and metal-sequestration confusables.

qualifier: multiciliated epithelial cells and mucociliary clearance
name: Multiciliated epithelial motile ciliogenesis and mucociliary clearance
rationale: Members cover multiciliogenesis transcription, de novo centriole/basal body formation, dynein arm assembly and mucociliary clearance, whereas confusables concern left-right cilia and sperm flagella.

qualifier: generic L-alpha-amino acid metabolism and catabolism
name: General L-alpha-amino acid metabolism and catabolism
rationale: All three (obsolete) members are generic alpha/L-amino acid metabolic and catabolic terms, broader than the specific tyrosine, phenylalanine and proline/glycine confusables.

qualifier: definitive endoderm and lateral plate mesoderm, gut tube morphogenesis
name: Gastrulation endoderm and lateral mesoderm formation, gut morphogenesis
rationale: Members span primitive streak and gastrulation, definitive endoderm specification, lateral plate mesoderm and foregut/hindgut morphogenesis, whereas confusables emphasise mesendoderm migration, EMT and pluripotency.

qualifier: TRAF6-TAK1 to canonical NF-kappaB, JNK and p38
name: Innate receptor TRAF6–TAK1 signaling to canonical NF-κB and JNK/p38
rationale: Members are TLR (MyD88/IRAK and TRIF), inflammasome and ALPK1 signalling converging on TRAF6/TAK1, K63 ubiquitination, IKK and JNK/p38, unlike the NOD, TNFR and non-canonical NF-kB confusables.

qualifier: CDC42 subfamily, RHOD and RND2/RND3
name: CDC42-subfamily, RHOD and RND GTPase cycles
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles of CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV, RHOD, RND2 and RND3 with formin/IQGAP effectors, distinct from the RHOA/B/C and RAC confusables.

qualifier: lysine methylation/demethylation, deacetylation and CHD-family remodelers
name: Histone lysine methylation, deacetylation and CHD-family chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members cover histone lysine methyltransferases/demethylases, HDACs, CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodelers and X inactivation, whereas confusables centre on DNA methylation/PRC2, BAF complexes or arginine methylation.

qualifier: midbrain dopaminergic neurons versus glia (oligodendrocytes, astrocytes, Bergmann glia)
name: Dopaminergic neuron and glial fate differentiation balance
rationale: Members regulate neuron versus glial differentiation, including midbrain dopaminergic neurons, cerebellar precursors and oligodendrocyte/astrocyte/Bergmann glia fates, unlike the forebrain progenitor and Schwann cell confusables.

qualifier: resting and LPS-activated DC surface markers
name: Dendritic cell surface signatures, resting and LPS-activated
rationale: Four of five members are resting/activated DC surface or DC-enriched modules (with one T cell module), distinguishing it from monocyte and B/T cell surface confusables.

qualifier: CDC42 subfamily and RHOD with formin and IQGAP effectors, no RND
name: CDC42-subfamily and RHOD GTPase cycles with formin, IQGAP effectors
rationale: Members are CDC42, RHOJ, RHOU, RHOV and RHOD cycles plus Gbg-CDC42, formin and IQGAP activation, whereas confusables carry RHOA/B/C, RHOG or RND cycles.

qualifier: planar cell polarity and Ca2+ branches with Wnt ligand secretion
name: Non-canonical Wnt/PCP and Ca2+ signaling with Wnt ligand secretion
rationale: Members cover PCP, convergent extension, Wnt/Ca2+ signalling and Wnt biogenesis/PORCN secretion, which the axial mesoderm, Hedgehog and left-right confusables lack.

qualifier: nuclear envelope disassembly/reformation and cytokinesis
name: Mitotic nuclear envelope remodeling, spindle midzone and cytokinesis
rationale: Members are nuclear envelope/lamina breakdown and ESCRT-III resealing, spindle midzone and contractile ring/abscission, distinct from the chromosome condensation, cohesion and spindle checkpoint confusables.
